description: A glowing crystal containing fractured source code from the elven mainframes.
A synthetic gemstone that traps wandering digital spirits.
Radiates a harsh crimson light. Highly valued by street-alchemists.
Constantly shifts between physical and holographic states.
Flawless, compressed carbon woven with arcane nano-threads.
A shard of pure magic shaped into a standard processing unit.
A green jewel bleeding with malicious glitch-magic.
An unrefined crystal geode that holds raw magical charge.
Bioluminescent gem found in the toxic techno-caverns.
Exists in multiple realities at once, warm to the touch.
An old tome humming with stored incantations. Read it to teach one new spell to a party member whose class can use it.
A humming shard of memory-crystal. Hold it to teach one new skill to a party member.
Placeholder chest loot. Expands into one random armor or weapon usable by the current party (regular tier).
Placeholder chest loot. Expands into one random armor or weapon usable by the current party (advanced tier).
Placeholder chest loot. Expands into one Bone-tier armor piece usable by the current party (Spartan/Shade/Warden/Amazon/Crusader/Ghostblade).
